description: This file defines the AutoEscapeNode class in the Twig templating engine, representing an autoescape node that manages escaping strategies within templates.

classes.name: AutoEscapeNode
classes.description: Represents an autoescape node in Twig, handling autoescaping strategies such as html or js within templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to create an AutoEscapeNode with a given escape strategy, body node, and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the autoescape node by delegating to its body node for further subcompilation.
